purpose: Turn canonical Song identity, current/approved lineage, scoped evidence and Activity into one pure-read Song Resume Brief so a returning artist can understand where they left off without N0TE inventing a decision or mutating state.

lineage.outcome: A returning artist gets one truthful Song brief: current, approved, what changed, unresolved conflicts and represented next action truth.
lineage.capability: Read-only Song Resume Brief over canonical Headquarters memory

completion_proof: reopen returns the same Artist/Song identity with CURRENT and APPROVED represented separately
recent Song Activity is chronological and excludes another Song
applicable same-scope evidence conflicts are surfaced with source/provenance and no selected winner
version-scoped evidence outranks broader Song/Artist/Profile evidence only by scope specificity
next action is UNKNOWN when absent, RESOLVED only when represented evidence resolves it, and CONFLICT when represented evidence conflicts
requesting a Resume Brief inserts/updates/deletes zero rows across canonical durable tables
missing/corrupt canonical references fail visibly rather than creating an empty/default brief
tests and consumer smoke require no DAW/provider dependency
non_scope: Technical Twin / Creative Twin visual UX
next_selection_rule: After CORE-01D proof, reconcile evidence and globally reselect. Do not continue read-model/UI work by adjacency.
